notes: Camera: calibrated setup ego camera (fovy 38, pitch 33.7, 0.558 m); the 10 cm grid lies on the cloth.

Ids follow Stage 1: disk_1 is the rightmost drive (x = 0.10), disk_2 the middle one, disk_3 the leftmost; they fill the top, second and fifth-from-top cage slots in that order (the slots the video shows filled).

Drive size: a standard 3.5-inch drive in a tray would be ~0.159 x 0.114 m, but the footprint width (0.091-0.094 m) and free-scale silhouette fits (0.80/0.91 on the two unoccluded drives) say the drives image ~12% smaller through this camera; the drives were built at 0.145 x 0.100 x 0.024 m outer to match the video, and the cage slots were sized from them (slot_w 0.108, slot_h 0.030, bay_depth 0.141).
Drive colour: measure_object_color on the drive masks reads 0.90-1.00 grey (silver casing and white label, partly overexposed); the casing is painted 0.90 grey.

Case shell and interior dressing (PSU, cooler, board) are approximate by design; the cage is exact geometry. The real case's stack shows a few occupied lower slots; the reconstruction leaves all eight slots empty.
Free-yaw fits flipped the drives by 180 deg (the silhouette is nearly symmetric); the final fit bounded yaw to +-15 deg around the tabs-toward-operator orientation seen in frame 0.
Reach: scene_qc warns that disk_2 at y = 0.37 m is 31 mm short of the LEFT arm's band; the right arm, which does every subgoal, reaches all three drives.
The grey slab at the image's far left (a second panel/case behind) was cut out of the case mask; it is not a Stage 1 object.
